evidence.summary: This is a generated starting point and has not yet been evaluated as a project-specific claim.

failure_modes.description: The claim is recorded without a resolvable proof artifact.
failure_modes.falsifier: Validation reports a missing or invalid required proof artifact.
failure_modes.observable_signal: The proof gate references a missing or invalid file.

measurements.collection_method: Run the command named by the proof gate.
measurements.definition: Whether the required validation command exits successfully.
measurements.name: Proof gate result

non_guarantees: The generated template is not evidence that the project capability has been measured.
The template does not replace human review or issue-scoped claim maintenance.

open_questions.question: Which project capability should replace this template claim first?

acceptance_criteria: Replace this template claim with a project-specific, issue-reviewed claim.
Keep all proof references resolvable and evidence status bounded by observation.
proof_gate.failure_behavior: Keep the claim unsupported and repair or remove the invalid proof reference before publication.

required_artifacts.relationship: contains the repository-owned claim and its evidence contract

claims.statement: A repository capability should not be treated as established until its baseline, observable condition, failure mode, measurements, and proof gate are recorded.
claims.title: Repository claims require explicit evidence
claims.why_it_matters: A structured claim prevents completion language from being mistaken for measured evidence.

governance.new_capability_rule: Every new capability must map to an existing claim or introduce a new falsifiable claim before it is treated as research-relevant.
governance.review_policy: Reviewers must check that every claim remains falsifiable, evidence status is bounded by observed evidence, proof references resolve, and schema compatibility is preserved.

methodology.falsifiability_standard: Every claim names a baseline, an observable condition, a failure mode, measurable evidence, and a proof gate.

measurement_rules.name: Proof reference
measurement_rules.requirement: A passing claim must identify the artifact or command that supports it.

purpose: Provide a schema-valid starting point for repository-owned, evidence-bounded claims.
